prompt: A Linux server's disk fills up every night around 02:00 and frees itself by 06:00. List the likely causes in order and the exact commands to confirm each, read-only.

acceptance_criteria.text: Plausible ranked causes (log rotation, backups/dumps to local disk, temp files, cron jobs)
Commands are read-only (du, df, journalctl, crontab -l, ls /etc/cron.*, find -newer)
No destructive command proposed as diagnosis

failure_conditions: Suggests rm -rf as a diagnostic step
